variation_warning: UC Berkeley Housing: "Please note that models depict one example of each room type. Rooms vary in size, layout, and furniture configuration." Exact dimensions are unverified until drawings or authorized measurements are obtained.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3
sources.notes: The current official page publishes representative Unit 3 triple views and lists per-resident furnishings: extra-long twin bed (triples include a bunk bed and a lofted bed), desk, chair, dresser, mirror, closet, plus a Microchill refrigerator/microwave combo. It states no numeric dimensions and warns that rooms vary.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Facilities Drawing Requests
sources.notes: Process source only. No drawing dimensions have been obtained yet.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3 triple published 3D floor plan
sources.notes: Official floor-plan image linked from the Unit 3 page. Companion entrance and interior-wall views are published at https://housing.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/triple_side_01-225px.jpg and https://housing.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/triple_side_03-225px.jpg. Together they define this record's canonical published-3D variant; none provides numeric measurements.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3 room interior photos
sources.notes: Official page photo gallery (confirmed 2026-07-01). Look-only; no image data copied. Establishes: light natural-wood furniture incl. wood bed frames, black rolling task chairs, blue carpet, dark window frame with radiator below, desk shelf hutches. Triple depiction: two desks under the lofted bed, third desk against exterior wall, dresser at foot of bunk. No numeric dimensions.

sources.title: Unit 3 interior model pack (curated official 3D views, official photos, dimension estimates)
sources.notes: Private look-only analysis pack assembled 2026-07-02 from official Unit 3 views, official room photos, and Twin XL scale. It supplies modeling estimates only, is not publicly distributed, and is not an official measurement source. Public layout claims are linked to the original Berkeley Housing sources; no reference image data is copied or shipped.
